findings.message: Audio bus architecture is well-structured: bus_setup.gd creates runtime buses, bus_setup.tscn is auto-loadable. All players correctly assigned to Music (-12dB), Voice (0dB), SFX (-6dB) buses.
Accessibility: Reduce-motion implemented via global instance pattern. All motion-heavy effects (camera shakes, particle effects) properly respect the flag.
AudioBank._ready() now uses synchronous initialization (comment confirms fix for previous race condition). All players constructed before any play_music() calls.
Safety-block audio feedback: Moderation check before AI, plays block_buzz SFX and block_oops voice on BLOCK. Properly wired through ModeratingSttAdapter.
World music lifecycle: Landing screen stops music before world switch, launcher stops music before play. Prevents audio overlap.
Captioning support with CaptionsOverlay class and Polish localization. Voice narration fallback via ElevenLabs TTS.
All audio assets normalized: SFX to -3dBFS target, music loop tails trimmed, UI SFX durations reduced. Automated analysis script verifies all files.
Comprehensive QA report with triage and CONDITIONAL PASS for Audio/Accessibility. Manual QA (screenshots/performance) blocked by Godot runtime, but code implementation is complete.
